scientific_integrity: Both the finite-parameter response formula and continuum-string precursor are cited and excluded from the novelty claim; mathematical asymptotics are proved separately. Numerical tests complement, rather than replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements only about the second-order coefficients of the published weak-coupling reduced Langevin chain. The weak-coupling remainder is not controlled uniformly in the von Mises concentration or lattice size; no microscopic-model instability, stationary law or limit interchange is proved.
title: Sharp mesh–localization crossover for active-bath oscillator friction
